_note: SYNTHETIC telemetry, invented for benchmark use. Not a real production sample.
definition: Every access decision the service resolved as allowed, sampled over the period.

allowed_access_by_membership_state.description: The user was a member of the owning team at the time of access.
The user had already left the owning team. The membership lookup still returned them as a member, so access was allowed.

stale_membership.cause: The membership directory is a cache, refreshed asynchronously from the upstream identity service. A membership row can outlive the membership.
stale_membership.note: Every one of the 88200 accesses above happened inside this window. None of them appear anywhere as a grant: the service had nothing to write down, so there is no record that these users could see these documents.

team_size.definition: Distinct users listed as members of one team.
